pain_point: Per-diem nurses and therapists who work at multiple facilities spend hours coordinating shift swaps via texts, emails, and paper notes, often missing coverage rules or credential requirements
target_user: Per-diem nurses, travel therapists, locum doctors
visual_style: Clinical Clipboard — medical clipboard paper background with ruled lines, die-cut style headers, bold highlighter-style status colors (green=confirmed, yellow=pending, red=urgent), monospaced times and facility codes, clean institutional feel with warmth
tech_stack: React + TypeScript + Vite, served via nginx in Docker
